summary: The icon-fill case decodes each raster once and reads the mark's aspect once per brand, and `pnpm test` runs under a 20 s per-case bound instead of vitest's 5 s default — a 2.3 s measurement was being reported as a failed assertion.
reader_impact: Nobody sees a different screen: the ink floors and every measured fraction are unchanged, and a swapped raster still reddens the case. Release cuts stop refusing a sha over a CPU-bound measurement on a loaded box.
